error.title: Unable to Load Statement
error.description: Something went wrong while loading your account statement.

criteria.title: Statement Criteria
criteria.description: Choose an account and date range to generate your account statement.

validation.fromDateFuture: From date cannot be in the future.
validation.toDateFuture: To date cannot be in the future.
validation.fromDateAfterToDate: From date cannot be later than to date.
validation.beforeOpeningDate: The selected date range cannot be before the account opening date.

form.informationTip: Statements can be generated for any date range between account opening date and today. You will have the option to verify your criteria before downloading.

verify.title: Verify Statement Details
verify.description: Please review your statement details before confirming.
verify.confirmationNote: Confirming these details will prepare your account statement for download. You can still return to make changes if needed.

ready.title: Statement Ready
ready.description: Your statement criteria have been confirmed. Choose your preferred export format below.

errors.title: Download Failed
errors.pdf: Unable to download the PDF statement. Please try again.
errors.csv: Unable to download the CSV statement. Please try again.

download.informationTip: You can download both PDF and CSV formats for your records. Click either button above to start your download.
